Corporate professional.context: Customer or employee experience with cross-functional contributors
Corporate professional.starting: Experience workshop: 2 days / 12 hours. Prepared challenge: 3–5-day sprint.

Student.context: Accessible real-world project with guided team practice
Student.starting: Project bootcamp: 3 days / 18 hours. Extended project: 24–30 facilitated hours over 4–6 weeks.

Startup founder/team.context: User needs, uncertain assumptions and the next venture experiment
Startup founder/team.starting: User problem sprint: 3 days / 18 hours. Confirmed feedback: 4–5 days.

Investor/incubator.context: Founder capability or user-focused venture work. No investment evaluation or due diligence.
Investor/incubator.starting: Cohort bootcamp: 2 days / 12 hours. Individual venture sprint: 3–5 days.

HR/L&D.context: Innovation capability or a defined employee experience
HR/L&D.starting: Capability workshop: 2 days / 12 hours plus a 2-hour application review. Live challenge: 3–4 days.

Corporate management.context: Leadership framing, decision boundaries, sponsor and frontline perspectives
Corporate management.starting: Leadership alignment: 1 day / 6 hours. Working-team sprint: 3–5 days.

Institution management.context: Student, faculty or staff experience with academic and operational constraints
Institution management.starting: Institutional experience workshop: 2 days / 12 hours. Prepared challenge: 3–4 days.
